ModMetaData.name: PUAH 1.5 Queue Hotfix V5.2
ModMetaData.author: Local hotfix
ModMetaData.description:
RimWorld 1.5 queue and performance hotfix for Pick Up And Haul.
V5.2 keeps V5.1's HaulToInventory queue repair and reservation crash guards, and adds a PUAH-specific performance layer for the multi-haul candidate search. It bypasses the redundant private haulable-list Sort inside JobOnThing and accelerates PUAH's FindClosestThing with an exact 16x16 spatial index while preserving PUAH's original RemoveAt, max-distance, CanReach, validator, storage, reservation, and job semantics. Any ambiguous index state falls back to PUAH's original linear search for that call.
RimWorld 1.5 PUAH 队列与性能修复 V5.2：保留 V5.1 的队列自修复与 reservation 防崩；新增 PUAH 专属性能层，跳过 JobOnThing 内部冗余的全列表排序，并用 16x16 精确空间索引加速 FindClosestThing。CanReach、validator、StoreUtility、Reservation、Job/队列逻辑仍由 PUAH/原版主线程执行；索引状态有任何疑问时单次调用自动回退 PUAH 原线性搜索。
